eligible_assets.wardrobe_basis: A private's dress of the First Infantry for August 1812: the issue the 1802 act lists, and the uniform change of 1813 read backwards, so a blue coat faced red and a felt cap with a feather. The cut, the colours and the fit are reconstructed. Accepted only for an anonymous private of the first Fort Dearborn's garrison, because none of its soldiers is a person in this project's records.

provenance.basis: Fallback only: prefer existing attested, inferred or reconstructed people as model references. Owner requested anonymous adult role figures. This 1812 profile identifies no resident, ancestry, likeness or attested individual. One wardrobe/body asset is accepted (T-3452): the First Infantry private, period-qualified for 1812 by its recipe; any other asset is refused until it is registered here with its own basis.
